Name: Alt Fashion Bachelorettes
Author: jupitersandwich
Description:
Portrait mod for all 6 bachelorettes :)
Each are dressed in Alternative fashion

Abigail: Goth
Emily: Hippie
Haley: Gyaru
Penny: Lolita
Leah: Mori Kei
Maru: Scene
Includes winter and beach outfits for all of them.
Unfortunately doesn't include their world sprites.

If you would like a version with the characters separated, you can ask me :)
Or, you can delete everyone else's spritesheets from the mod's assets folder. Don't worry about programming.

Only requires SMAPI and ContentPatcher.
Just unpack and put the [CP]AltFashionBachelorettes folder into your stardew mods folder.
